summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature without running tests or repository code, and without committing. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in the ControlCode union. rich/control.py adds the format entry "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and Control.title(title), which passes the (SET_WINDOW_TITLE, title) pair as one constructor argument. rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) -> bool beside set_alt_screen, gated only on is_terminal, with the required docstring warnings. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif branch at the end of the dispatch chain that calls term.set_title(title) once per title code. CHANGELOG.md gets an Added heading above Fixed with a bullet linking PR 2200. Tests added: test_set_window_title (tests/test_console.py, returns early on legacy consoles), test_control_title (tests/test_control.py), and test_control_set_window_title (tests/test_windows_renderer.py, Windows-only). One mistake was made and fixed during editing: the renderer branch was first inserted inside the ERASE_IN_LINE block; it was moved to its own elif, and the original ERASE_IN_LINE code is unchanged. Nothing has been executed, so the tests and mypy are unverified.
